releaseNotes:
⚡ v1.8.7 Flagship Missed Call Auto-SMS & AI Conflict Resolution:
• 🚀 Instant Missed Call Auto-SMS: Pacing respects configured natural delay (minimum 2s) rather than 40s AI conversational pacing
• 🛡️ CallLog Polling Safeguard: Async polling ensures missed calls on modern Android devices are reliably captured even if OS intent extras are delayed
• 🎙️ Auto-SMS vs Vapi Conflict Resolution: Active voice call reconciliation buffer tightened to 45s. Vapi in-progress answers immediately mute canned SMS
• 🔐 $9.99 Plan Entitlement Gating: Conversational AI replies strictly gated to active $9.99/mo voice & SMS subscribers
• 🔄 Dropped Call Recovery SMS: Contextual text automatically dispatched if voice calls disconnect or drop prematurely
